arguments.message:
Hi! When you migrate your workspace to a new plan, your existing integrations stay fully functional – API keys, webhooks and automation rules keep running without any re‑configuration because they’re tied to the workspace, not the plan tier.

Before you confirm the migration, you can check the status of every rule in Settings → Automation → Rules. If a rule uses a feature that only exists on the destination tier, it will activate right after the migration. If it relies on a feature that the destination tier doesn’t include, the rule will be paused (not deleted) and will automatically reactivate if you ever move back to a tier that supports it.

So, in short: no changes to your integration endpoints or keys, and your automation rules will either stay active or pause based on the capabilities of the new tier. Let me know if you’d like a deeper walk‑through of any specific rule or integration!
